name: chadscript
description: A JavaScript to native code compiler using LLVM

scripts.test:both: npm run test:node && npm run test:native
scripts.test:fast: npm run build && CHADC_COMPILER='.build/chad' node --import tsx --test tests/smoke.test.ts
scripts.test:parity: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/ast-parity.test.ts
scripts.coverage: CHADC_COMPILER='node dist/chad-node.js' c8 node --import tsx --test tests/compiler.test.ts tests/unit/symbol-table.test.ts tests/unit/type-system.test.ts
scripts.prepare: HOOKS=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks && git config core.hooksPath "$HOOKS" && cp scripts/pre-commit "$HOOKS/pre-commit" && chmod +x "$HOOKS/pre-commit" && cp scripts/pre-push "$HOOKS/pre-push" && chmod +x "$HOOKS/pre-push"

author: Chad Smith
